justification: The most specific correspondence is an upright stone surface carrying schematic carved motifs with a circular element in the central area and horizontal/parallel banding below or nearby. The biggest difference is that A is organized as a flatter, rectilinear, register-like relief with multiple small animal/abstract forms, while B reads as a single dark anthropomorphic monolith with symmetrical body-like features and fewer, larger incised motifs.
